meta.title: Company | Piroliswiss
meta.description: Piroliswiss S.R.L. by Grupo Zwald S.R.L.: producer and exporter of premium charcoal and pyrolysis by-products. Team and company details. Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia.

intro.label: Who we are
intro.title: Industrial producers and exporters of premium charcoal and pyrolysis by-products.
intro.lede: Piroliswiss is a company specialised in producing and exporting charcoal and high-value by-products, developed with industrial technology and efficient processes to reach high standards of quality and performance. We operate under a responsible and sustainable model, using forest biomass of legal origin and turning it entirely into high-value products.

items.label: Industrial production
items.text: We combine carbonisation technology in industrial metal retorts with controlled processes, joining precision, efficiency and operational control to deliver products of uniform quality, high yield and consistent specifications for demanding markets.

items.label: Responsible sourcing
items.text: We work exclusively with forest biomass of legal origin and authorised provenance, recovering resources that would otherwise be burned or wasted. Through efficient industrial processes we turn them into high-value products, reducing waste, pollution and the loss of raw material with high productive potential.

items.label: Based in
items.text: Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia. Developed with Grupo Zwald S.R.L., which provides operating know-how, technology and commercial channels.
